spec.title: [TX] TS Fetch time (ms)
spec.description: Time it takes to return for the flesnet source.get() call

spec.title: [TX] Memory Management per TS fetch (µs)
spec.description: Time takes to create the buffer map representation for a Timeslice

spec.query: SELECT mean("buffer_fill") FROM "timeslice_forwarder_state" WHERE ("receiver"::tag != '') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host"::tag fill(null)

spec.title: [TX] Finding Space on Remote (µs)
spec.description: Time needed to calculate the transmission addresses based on the remote buffer map and the sender buffer map.

spec.title: [TX] CM Response Time (ms)
spec.description: Time it takes for the CM to respond after requesting a receiver node for the Timeslice transmission

spec.title: [TX] Transmission Delay time (ms)
spec.description: Time it take from requesting a transmission target receiver to performing the transmission, including buffer map locking and address calculations.

spec.title: [CM] Node Evaluation Time (ms)
spec.description: Time it takes to evaluate the current network status

spec.title: [TX] CM Request Time (ms)
spec.description: Time it takes to send a transmission request to the CM

spec.title: [RX] Receive Memory Management (µs)
spec.description: Time needed between receicing a timeslice and sending the SHM work item.

spec.query: SELECT mean("buffer_map_fill") FROM "timeslice_forwarder_state" WHERE ("receiver"::tag != '') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host"::tag fill(null)
SELECT mean("buffer_fill") FROM "timeslice_forwarder_state" WHERE ("sender"::tag != '') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host"::tag fill(null)
SELECT mean("buffer_map_fill") FROM "timeslice_forwarder_state" WHERE ("sender"::tag != '') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host"::tag fill(null)
